pages.text: Health starts at 16 and gains 4 per point; upgrades do not heal. Attack starts at 2 and gains 1, serving Combat and Dragon melee, Dragon breath, and Guardian Angel beams. Defense starts at 0 and gains 1 using normal armor rules.

Movement Speed starts at 0.30, gaining 0.015 per point. It shortens ground-hop pauses and scales mounted flight; ground-hop launch speed stays fixed. Work Speed starts at 1× and gains 0.1×, affecting job action intervals and effective-tool mining.
Common Capacity starts at 9 slots and gains 3 per point, up to 27. Transport always has twice that capacity; warehouses eight times. Capacity has six upgrades, while the other stats have twenty.

Stamina starts at 100 and gains 20 per point. Reach starts at 3 blocks and gains 0.25. Detection Range starts at 8 and gains 1; farming, logging, healing, and abundance multiply it by 2, cleaning by 5.

The management screen marks stats unused by the current job. Investments persist when a Friendly Slime specializes. Guardian Angel and Royal Guard health is four times the common value; Attention movement is 1.5 times the common value at identical base stats.
